title: Illuminated metal keys
description: Three backlit keys cast amber, white or blue reflections across a shared metal housing.
useCase: Make a selected control feel connected to its surroundings through localized reflected light.
interaction: Select a light color to illuminate its key and the metal above it.
reducedMotion: Selection and reflected light update immediately. Keyboard selection also skips transitions.
limitations: Three local color presets with authored CSS reflections. No connected light hardware, arbitrary DOM reflection engine or physically based lighting simulation. No canvas or WebGL required.
look: Brushed-silver plate on a dark graphite backdrop with three dark glass keys in chrome bezels, line icons, labels, and amber light spilling onto the metal.
motion: Selecting a key fades its lens illumination and emitter glow on and crossfades a coloured reflection across the housing above it over 220 ms; pressing dips the bezel 2 px.
adapt: Light is pure CSS: each `.sf-contact-metal-reflection` stacks radial gradients at `--source-x` tinted by `--light`, toggled by `data-lit` with `opacity 220ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)`; selected keys light `.sf-contact-metal-illumination` and `.sf-contact-metal-emitter`. Edit `LIGHTS` for colours and labels.
